semantic_type_preservation_rule: Each cultural entity MUST retain its authoritative semantic type. GI_PRODUCT, CRAFT_CLUSTER, and OFFICIAL_FOOD_REFERENCE are distinct ontological categories with different legal and provenance semantics. They must NOT be merged, flattened, or transformed into generic Place objects in any mobile data layer.

datasets.authority: CGPDTM — Geographical Indications Registry of India (statutory)
datasets.attribution_text: Geographical Indications Registry — CGPDTM, Government of India
datasets.notes: Statutory GI records. Do not infer producer locations from GI filing area. Do not transform into map Place pins without explicit coordinate evidence.

datasets.authority: DC Handicrafts & DC Handlooms (Ministry of Textiles) / State Craft Council
datasets.change_trigger: Official cooperative dissolution or new cluster registration
datasets.attribution_text: DC Handicrafts / DC Handlooms — Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
datasets.notes: artisan_count is a MUTABLE_CONTACT class field — subject to annual census changes. Do not bundle as static fact. Coordinates are cluster-centroid level, not individual artisan homes.

datasets.authority: CGPDTM GI Registry (GI-registered dishes) + FSSAI (food safety hub)
datasets.change_trigger: GI Journal notification or FSSAI regulatory update
datasets.attribution_text: Geographical Indications Registry — CGPDTM; FSSAI — Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
datasets.notes: GI food records reference dishes and origin regions, not individual restaurants. Do not associate with specific eatery locations without verified evidence.

hard_invariants: GI_PRODUCT, CRAFT_CLUSTER, OFFICIAL_FOOD_REFERENCE must be preserved as distinct semantic types in all mobile data layers.
Do NOT merge cultural entities into Place objects.
artisan_count field must not be bundled as a static numeric fact.
No AI-generated descriptions or coordinates may substitute for verified source data.
